title: Share Trading Policy

tiers.name: EOL Staff
tiers.description: All directors, employees and contractors of the Company. Subject to the insider trading prohibition, blackout periods, the ban on short-term/hedge/derivative trading, and the secured-lending approval requirement.

tiers.name: Connected Parties
tiers.description: Spouse or partner, immediate family members (parents, children, siblings, in-laws), and entities under the EOL Staff member's control, influence, or in which they hold a significant beneficial interest.

tiers.name: KMP
tiers.description: EOL Staff filling a role included in the Remuneration Report of the latest Annual Report; the Executive Leadership Team has the same obligations as KMP even if not KMP for financial reporting purposes.

tiers.name: Senior Finance Staff
tiers.description: EOL Finance Staff with a direct reporting relationship to the Group CFO or a Region General Manager, including employees undertaking company secretarial activities or attending Board meetings in that capacity.

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The Board may declare a blackout period at any such time it deems circumstances require one; the policy does not address whether such a declaration is confidential.

rules.detail: Outright ban, with no clearance route, on any derivative-type trading in Company securities, applicable to all EOL Staff and Connected Parties regardless of vesting state; this squarely catches an OTC put and call with a bank.
rules.evidence: EOL Staff (including Connected Parties) are not permitted to undertake any short-term, short selling, speculative, hedge or derivative type trading in Company securities.

rules.detail: The 2.3 ban on 'hedge ... type trading in Company securities' is not limited to unvested holdings; it applies to all Company securities.

rules.detail: Separate, additional express ban specifically on transactions limiting the economic risk of unvested employee share scheme entitlements, on top of the general 2.3 ban.
rules.evidence: It is prohibited for EOL Staff to enter into transactions or arrangements which limit the economic risk of unvested entitlements under an employee share scheme.

clearance.evidence: Approval to trade inside a “blackout” of the Company trading periods will generally be valid for 5 business days from the clearance being granted by the Chairman but can be extended for exceptional circumstances on a case-by-case basis.

financing_disclosure: EOL Staff: trigger = inception, before entering into any agreement giving a lender rights over their EOL securities; to whom = the Chairman (or the Chair of the Audit & Risk Committee if the Chairman is unavailable); deadline = prior written approval must be obtained before entering into the arrangement.

exemption_authority: The Chairman (or the Board if the Chairman is unavailable) may grant, refuse or withdraw any clearance to trade at EOL's sole discretion and without explanation; the clearance is final and binding and must be kept confidential by the person seeking it. The Chairman also has discretion to exempt a connected party's independent bona fide trading from the policy entirely.

bespoke_clauses.clause: EOL Staff (including Connected Parties) are not permitted to undertake any short-term, short selling, speculative, hedge or derivative type trading in Company securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This is an outright, unqualified ban on all derivative and hedge transactions in EOL securities for every EOL Staff member and Connected Party, with no clearance route and no vesting-state carve-out; both legs of an OTC collar (the purchased put and the written call) are 'derivative type trading' and 'hedge ... trading', so the collar structure itself cannot be entered into, regardless of how the loan leg is treated.

bespoke_clauses.clause: EOL Staff must not enter into agreements that provide lenders with rights over their interests in securities in the Company without first seeking and obtaining prior written approval from the Chairman.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The loan/security leg alone (e.g. a conventional margin loan on unencumbered vested shares) is not banned and can be approved by the Chairman, confirming that the blocker is specifically the derivative/hedge ban rather than secured lending as such.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Any clearance to trade: May be granted, refused or withdrawn at the sole discretion of EOL and without further explanation; Is final and binding on the person requesting the clearance; Must be kept confidential by the person seeking clearance and not disclosed to anyone.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even for the permissible financing leg, any approval obtained can be withdrawn without reasons and must be kept secret by the executive, limiting the ability to coordinate openly with the bank about clearance status.

bespoke_clauses.clause: For the purposes of this Share Trading Policy the Executive Leadership Team will have the same obligations in terms of this policy as KMP (even though the respective ELT member may not be KMP from a financial reporting perspective.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The heightened Chairman pre-approval and scrutiny regime for KMP extends to the whole Executive Leadership Team, broadening the population facing the strictest process (though this does not affect the outright derivative/hedge ban, which applies to all EOL Staff regardless).

summary: A funded collar is not possible under this policy. Section 2.3 imposes an outright, unqualified ban on 'hedge or derivative type trading' in Company securities for all EOL Staff and Connected Parties, with no exception for vested holdings and no clearance route, which directly prohibits both the purchased put and written call legs of the structure. This sits alongside a further express ban on limiting the economic risk of unvested employee share scheme entitlements. By contrast, the loan/security leg is separately regulated and would be permitted with the Chairman's (or Audit & Risk Committee Chair's) prior written approval, so a conventional secured loan against unencumbered vested shares is not itself prohibited. However, because the derivative legs cannot be entered into at all, the funded collar as a package cannot be implemented, and any clearance obtained for the financing leg alone would be discretionary, revocable without reasons, and must be kept confidential by the executive.
